hooks.command: sh -c 'if [ -r "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/kevin-voice.md" ]; then cat "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/kevin-voice.md"; else printf "%s\n" "Use Kevin voice: fewest clear words, prose only."; fi'
hooks.commandWindows: if (Test-Path "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT\kevin-voice.md") { Get-Content -Raw "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT\kevin-voice.md" } else { Write-Output "Use Kevin voice: fewest clear words, prose only." }
